purpose: Minimal patch for a confirmed issue, limited to exactly the listed files, against base hashes.

allowed_paths.description: the exact files that may change and the new files that may be created (both decided by the application)

file_snapshots.description: each file as a fenced UNTRUSTED_DATA block whose header is [E<n>] path (sha256 base hash); read-only files are marked

feedback.description: verification result of the previous attempt, when iterating (fenced, untrusted)
